rules.description: Helmet evidence is visible for the person.
The person is missing helmet evidence in an active work area.
rules.recommended_action: Supervisor should verify helmet compliance in the active work area.

rules.description: The person is missing helmet evidence inside a restricted zone.
rules.recommended_action: Trigger a critical alert and verify restricted-zone access immediately.

rules.description: The person is missing helmet evidence in a work-at-height zone.
rules.recommended_action: Trigger a critical alert and verify work-at-height PPE immediately.

rules.description: No-helmet evidence occurs in a PPE-exempt zone.
rules.recommended_action: Do not alert; retain the grounded exception for audit.

rules.description: Helmet evidence is uncertain in a PPE-controlled zone.
rules.recommended_action: Escalate to human review before sending an alert.

rules.description: Helmet evidence is uncertain in a PPE-exempt zone.
rules.recommended_action: Retain for review without sending a safety alert.

rules.description: No-helmet evidence has no reliable zone grounding.
rules.recommended_action: Escalate to human review because zone grounding is unavailable.

rules.description: No configured helmet-zone rule applies to the normalized evidence.
rules.recommended_action: Take no action and retain the no-match reason for audit.
